title: oku external-references registry
description: One domain-scoped ext-ref registry. Lives under kit/extrefs/<domain>.json (or a project's kit.json override). Loaded at runtime by chrome.js and consulted whenever an <ext-ref> inline is rendered. Same shape as glossary but each entry carries name + summary + link instead of def.

$schema.description: Optional schema URL for editor autocomplete.

domain.description: Domain name. Must match the filename. Used to disambiguate when the same entity is registered under two domains.

entries.description: Map of canonical name → per-language entry. The name key is the canonical spelling; case-insensitive for lookup.

name.description: Display name shown in the tooltip header.

summary.description: One-paragraph description of the entity. Plain text; no markup.

link.description: Canonical URL. Tooltip exposes a Learn more button to this link.
